data.body: Gerrit patchset 2 CI upstream blocker: run 31641453023 packaging/provenance/identity/ticket/golden-path jobs passed, but all three completed pytest matrix jobs failed before pytest at the base complexity lock. Exact reproduction on current origin/main 104dc4e10a: close_ticket ceiling raised 17 -> 19. This story changes only docs/plan-review-gate.md, the packaged guide/pins, and test_guides.py.
